description: This file defines the Notification model class within the Opencart admin tool module. It provides methods to add, edit, delete, retrieve, and count notification records in the database, encapsulating database interactions related to notifications.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: A model class responsible for CRUD operations on notification records in the database within the Opencart admin tool module.

methods.name: addNotification
methods.description: Inserts a new notification record into the database and returns the inserted record's ID.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of an existing notification record identified by its ID.

methods.name: deleteNotification
methods.description: Deletes a notification record from the database by its ID.

methods.name: getNotification
methods.description: Retrieves a notification record from the database by its ID.

methods.name: getNotifications
methods.description: Fetches multiple notification records based on optional filter criteria.

methods.name: getTotalNotifications
methods.description: Returns the total count of notification records matching optional filters.
